answer: Tranche-locked vesting releases rewards after a withdrawal delay crossing a dawn epoch boundary; each identity signs a liveness pulse to keep vesting and posts a timber-denominated bond forfeited on early exit. An attacker pays bond per attempt, stays under a rate cap, and waits a trust ramp of quorum-attested epochs before earnings unlock. A coordinated ring fails because its mutual attestations are correlated, the distinct-counterparty quorum rejects them, and abandoned identities lose bond plus unvested rewards.
